st.headline: HSBC first-half profit jumps 23% on higher rates, robust wealth growth
st.teaser: HSBC announced a resumption of its share buybacks with an up to US$1 billion plan.
fullText: HONG KONG/LONDON - HSBC Holdings reported on Aug 4 a 23 per cent first-half profit surge that bettered expectations, as rising net interest income and revenue from wealth management pushed up fee income on robust money and deal flows.
Europe’s largest bank posted a pretax profit of US$19.5 billion (S$25 billion) for the first six months of this year, versus US$15.8 billion a year earlier.
That compared with the US$18.9 billion average of broker estimates compiled by HSBC.
HSBC announced a resumption of its share buybacks with an up to US$1 billion plan, the first since it took smaller Hong Kong lender Hang Seng Bank private.
The bank also announced a second interim dividend of 10 US cents per share, following a similar payout in May. REUTERS

cna.headline: Maroon 5 to perform at Singapore's National Stadium in February 2027
cna.teaser: The American pop band is returning to Singapore for a one-night concert on Feb 12, 2027. Tickets go on sale from Aug 11.
fullText: Maroon 5 fans can mark their calendars: The Grammy-winning American band will return to Singapore to perform at the National Stadium on Feb 12, 2027.
Tickets will first be available on Ticketmaster through the Maroon 5 artist presale on Aug 11, from 10am to 11.59pm, for active standard Maroon 5 S.I.N. fan club members.
The UOB Reserve and Visa Infinite Cards presale will run on Aug 12 from 10am to 3pm, followed by the UOB Visa Cards presale from 5pm on Aug 12 to 10am on Aug 13.
The Live Nation presale for members will take place on Aug 13, from 12pm to 11.59pm. General ticket sales start on Aug 14 at 10am.

Known for hits such as She Will Be Loved, Payphone, Moves Like Jagger and Won't Go Home Without You, the band is bringing its latest international tour to Singapore as part of its Asia leg, which also includes stops in Kaohsiung, Tokyo, Seoul, Jakarta, Manila and Bangkok.

Maroon 5 recently wrapped up the European leg of their tour, as well as 24 arena shows across the United States in support of their latest album Love Is Like. The group's latest single, Heroine, was released in May.

The band first performed in Singapore at the Singapore Indoor Stadium in 2008 and went on to perform at the 2012 and 2015 Singapore Grand Prix. The group's most recent Singapore concert was at the National Stadium in November 2022.

listening.title: Singapore's Hawker Culture Goes Digital
listening.transcript: As Singapore embraces digital transformation, many traditional hawkers are adopting e-payment systems to streamline transactions. While older vendors initially resisted the shift, government incentives and peer mentoring have successfully bridged the digital divide. Today, customers can easily scan SGQR codes to purchase their favorite chicken rice or laksa, ensuring this culinary heritage remains active in a cashless society.

economistArticle.title: Frugal Innovation: How China Outpaces America’s AI Bounty
paras: While Silicon Valley continues to pour astronomical sums of capital into massive, compute-heavy artificial intelligence models, Chinese tech giants are charting a conspicuously different course. Faced with strict export curbs on high-end semiconductors and tighter venture funding, firms in Beijing and Shenzhen have turned constraints into a catalyst for ingenuity. They are proving that in the race for AI dominance, financial extravagance is not the only metric of success.

The core of China’s strategy lies in architectural efficiency. Instead of blindly chasing raw parameter count—a pursuit that demands thousands of cutting-edge Nvidia chips—Chinese researchers are optimizing existing open-source frameworks. By focusing on algorithmic refinement and data pruning, developers have managed to train remarkably agile models. These systems deliver comparable, and sometimes superior, task performance at a fraction of the computational footprint.

Furthermore, the pragmatic application of AI in China’s domestic market has accelerated this cost-effective evolution. Companies leverage highly specific consumer datasets to fine-tune smaller, domain-specific models rather than bloated general-purpose ones. This targeted approach has yielded robust commercial applications in fintech, smart logistics, and localized e-commerce, offering immediate utility and revenue without the exorbitant overhead of American alternatives.

This disparity in resource allocation highlights a deeper philosophical divide between the two superpowers. America’s tech behemoths operate under a trial-and-error paradigm, subsidized by venture capital and cloud computing rents. Conversely, Chinese firms operate under severe resource scarcity, forcing them to treat computing power as a precious commodity. Consequently, their lean engineering teams have mastered the art of squeezing maximal performance out of legacy hardware.

Ultimately, America’s raw investment leads the world, but its yield per dollar spent is facing diminishing returns. If China can continue to deliver high-performing AI products while bypassing the need for endless silicon, the global technological landscape may undergo a profound shift. The future of AI might belong not to those with the deepest pockets, but to those who can squeeze the most value from every byte.
economistArticle.cn: 尽管硅谷继续向庞大、计算量巨大的AI模型投入天文数字般的资金，但中国科技巨头正在开辟一条截然不同的道路。面对高端半导体的严苛出口限制和更紧缩的风险投资，北京和深圳的企业已将限制转化为创新的催化剂。他们正在证明，在AI霸权的竞争中，财务上的奢华并非衡量成功的唯一指标。中国战略的核心在于架构效率。中国研究人员没有盲目追求原始参数数量——这种追求需要成千上万颗尖端的英伟达芯片，而是致力于优化现有的开源框架。通过专注于算法精简和数据剪枝，开发人员已经成功训练出极其敏捷的模型。这些系统以极低的计算占用，实现了可比甚至更优越的任务性能。此外，AI在中国国内市场的务实应用加速了这种具有成本效益的演进。企业利用高度特定的消费者数据集来微调较小的、特定领域的模型，而不是臃肿的通用模型。这种针对性的方法在金融科技、智能物流和本地化电商中产生了强大的商业应用，无需美国替代方案那种高昂的经常性开支即可提供即时效用和收入。这种资源配置上的差异凸显了两大国之间更深层次的哲学分歧。美国的科技巨头在风险资本和云计算租金的支持下，以试错范式运行。相反，中国企业在严峻的资源匮乏下运营，迫使他们将计算能力视为珍贵的商品。因此，他们精干的工程团队已经掌握了从传统硬件中挤出最大性能的艺术。最终，美国的原始投资领先全球，但其每美元投入的产出正面临边际效益递减。如果中国能够继续提供高性能的AI产品，同时避开对无尽芯片的需求，全球技术格局可能会发生深刻转变。AI的未来可能不属于那些口袋最深的人，而属于那些能从每一个字节中挤出最大价值的人。

gems.s: Faced with strict export curbs on high-end semiconductors and tighter venture funding, firms in Beijing and Shenzhen have turned constraints into a catalyst for ingenuity.
gems.why: This sentence uses an introductory participle phrase ('Faced with...') to establish background context, followed by the metaphor 'turned constraints into a catalyst' which vividly describes overcoming adversity. This is excellent for persuasive writing in professional contexts. / 这句话使用了分词短语作状语（'Faced with...'）来建立背景语境，随后使用了比喻“将限制转化为催化剂”，生动地描述了克服逆境的过程。这非常适合在职场及专业写作中进行说服性表达。
